managed_policy_calibration.purpose: unique-action managed gross-value episodes and temporal out-of-sample validation

rolling_validation.purpose: post-fit component falsification; previously revealed slices cannot select parameters

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final structural reveal only after every v2.2 gate passes

revealed_development_diagnostic.purpose: post-fit execution falsification only; excluded from fit and parameter selection

leakage_rules: Playbook belief remains a structural path proposition and is never a managed-return label.
Equivalent playbook hypotheses may share one action identity but their probabilities are not summed as independent evidence.
Managed-value labels begin at the actual risk-approved unique-action clock and include later fill/expiry and frozen management outcomes.
June-July 2024 MBO may falsify but cannot fit or select v2.2 parameters.
AI review may emit only registered primitive proposals and has no action, outcome or profit-label authority.
Any holdout-driven change creates a later protocol and may not reuse the revealed holdout as confirmation.
